scope: Bounded stratified diagnostic of the explicit stopped-pouch0.5kg physical prototype. One force-driven loading recipe cannot establish universal input validity; seating failures and poor throws are preserved separately from numeric faults.

protocol.phases: Actual bounded motor; torso/head/offset physical grip; unheld gravity settling; canonical same-solver prediction/live launch; first world impact or15s flight.
protocol.equipment: Acquired and equipped in isolated in-memory economy state through actual reducers. No user save or account writes.
protocol.surfaceDetection: Suspected surface penetration means a part COM crossed through authored material depth with no matching recent per-part surface impulse. Candidates require review; this is not proof of continuous-collision failure.
protocol.finiteChecks: Every diagnostic step inspects every dynamic body and rope/revolute joint. Energy residual is mechanical-energy change minus recorded hand/motor/control/damping/drag/spawn work.
protocol.runtime: Node wall time includes prediction and diagnostic scanning; not browser FPS.
